entry_route.value: Applicants apply from a bachelor's in biology, or another field with 12 advanced biology hours.
entry_route.quote: A Bachelor's degree in Biology or a Bachelor's degree in some other discipline with at least 12 hours of advanced level coursework (junior or senior level courses) in Biology.

supervisor.value: The rotation route needs no faculty sponsor; only the direct-admit route needs a faculty member's support before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants admitted into the program will perform three rotations in three separate labs

also.quote: To qualify as a direct admit, an applicant must secure the support of a faculty member before applying

toefl_min.value: The page sets only speaking minimums: TOEFL iBT Speaking 23 or IELTS Speaking 7. The university overall score still applies.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum score of 23 on the Speaking portion of the TOEFL iBT exam or a minimum score of 7 on the Speaking portion of the IELTS exam

funding.value: Scholarships and fellowships follow the same criteria as admission, for students new in the Fall semester.
funding.quote: Award of scholarships or fellowships will be based on consideration of the same criteria utilized in admission decisions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

deadline.value: The page gives no date. Rotation applications are considered only for the Fall semester.

notes: Two routes: the rotation program (no faculty sponsor needed) and direct admit (faculty support needed before applying). A letter of intent and a department questionnaire are required (catalog).
name: Quantitative Biology PhD
